if: input tax credit is claimed on a supply
the tax charged in respect of that supply has NOT been actually paid to the Government, in cash or through utilisation of admissible input tax credit
then: credit of that input tax is DENIED, subject to the provisions of section 41
note: The only condition the recipient cannot verify from his own records — it turns on the supplier's conduct. Section 41 provisionally credits self-assessed eligible input tax, which is why the clause is expressed 'subject to the provisions of section 41'. A recipient's file can evidence the other three conditions and still fail this one. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.
